text:
Priya: Hey all — starting today! Quick onboarding Qs: who owns GCP project access for Dedicated infra (service accounts, firewall rules)? Also who do I ping to get a Dedicated capacity seat assigned for testing? And what's the escalation path if a nightly job fails and oncall doesn't respond?

Jorge: welcome! For Dedicated infra access, start with eng-infra (cc @Aisha). Aisha owns the IAM groups + project invites.

Aisha: hi @Priya :wave: — send me your company email and the project ID you need. For Dedicated test seats we have a reservation flow, I'll link it.

Priya: thanks @Aisha — email is priya@redwood.com. The project is "dedicated-staging-3" — will that be fine?

Aisha: yup — I'll add you to group redwood-dedicated-devs in ~30m. If you need a service account, say the name and scopes. Example we use: ```sa-name: redwood-ci-bot role: roles/ml.inferenceUser```

Tom: for Dedicated capacity assignment (testing slots) ping #eng-platform-bookings or file a ticket in our infra tracker (link: https://go/redwood/infra-bookings). If it's urgent, mention "priority:onboarding" in the ticket.

Priya: got it. And escalation? If a nightly job fails and page isn't acknowledged for >15m, is there a fallback?

Jorge: our escalation is: oncall -> secondary oncall -> eng-sre pager -> eng-infra rotation. If still unresolved after 30m, ops-manager gets notified. The runbook is at https://go/redwood/runbooks/nightly-jobs.

infra-bot: IncidentPolicy: page sent to #eng-oncall rotation (2m). If unacked after 10m, escalate to secondary rotation.

Aisha: for ownership map, see this quick list (feel free to DM if anything's missing): 
- IAM & project invites: eng-infra (Aisha)
- Dedicated capacity bookings: eng-platform (Tom)
- Oncall/escalation: eng-sre (Jorge)
- Access exceptions (legal/compliance): security-eng

Priya: perfect — that's super helpful. One last tiny ask: will there be a short onboarding doc for Dedicated-specific dev flows (how to run locally vs on Dedicated)?

Tom: yes — eng-platform maintains a short checklist: https://go/redwood/onboard/dedicated-dev-checklist. If anything in there is unclear open a PR on the repo.

Priya: thanks everyone! tagging this thread so I can reference it later :pray:
